item.title: Monal v6.4.24
item.description:
Monal 6.4.24 | Monal
- Added DNSSEC bug warning - Fixed spurious MUC join errors - Fixed playback of received mp3 files - Fixed vanishing toolbar buttons in active chats list - Fixed sharing location from Google Maps - Switched from iOS bundled libxml2 to new rust based xml parser to fix crashes - Now only accepting Channel/Group invites from contacts approved to our contact list - Fixed deeply nested xml DoS vector in push notification handler - Fixed several crashes
